body.prompt: Real aerial drone footage of Lisbon, Portugal, filmed on a clear October afternoon: Praça do Comércio, the Baixa grid and the Alfama rooftops beside the Tagus. Photorealistic: weathered terracotta roof tiles, limestone and painted plaster façades with real windows and shutters, calçada pavement, real trees, real cars, the river with natural reflections and small waves, soft atmospheric haze, natural sunlight and shadows. Smooth camera motion.
